added.summary: A district can name a terrain asset with `terrain "terrain/land.ogt" { depth 0.25 }` to carve its street and pavement footprint at cook time, using the existing TerrainStamp kernel. Block interiors and ground already lower are preserved. Region grids and path turns work alike; tiles, terrain colliders, sampling and terrain nav bakes use the same carved heights. District and terrain share local coordinates; streets remain at y = 0, without runtime generation or automatic grade selection.
